title: Pure Temple of the Kings
summary: The 2025 Temple of the Kings cards with the Apophis Traps and Serket monsters that mention the Temple, plus generic staples. Ra's Dangers of the Divine, which Defense of the Temple can fetch, belongs to the Egyptian God decks and stays out. The Man with the Mark searches Temple of the Kings or any card that mentions it, and while the Temple is up it keeps itself, your Apophis monsters and the Temple from being destroyed. Treasures of the Kings counts as Temple of the Kings in the Field Zone, sets an Apophis Trap from the Deck, and searches a Temple monster. The Temple lets those Traps be used the turn they are Set. Apophis the Serpent sets the next Apophis Trap, Anubis the Last Judge comes back from the GY once three Traps are there, and two Apophis monsters become Divine Serpent Apophis, which resets them from the GY. Verdict of Anubis negates a Spell/Trap and wipes their monsters.
main: The Man with the Mark
Starter: searches Temple of the Kings or a card that mentions it; protects the Temple and the Apophis monsters.
Anubis the Last Judge
Sends itself to search The Man with the Mark; returns from the GY on three Traps; destroys a card.
Merciless Scorpion of Serket
Summons itself by banishing a Level 10; searches Temple of the Kings or a Spell that mentions it.
Mystical Beast of Serket
Feeds the Temple's own effect to summon from the Deck or Extra Deck.
Temple of the Kings
Traps can be used the turn they are Set.
Treasures of the Kings
Field Spell that counts as the Temple: sets an Apophis Trap and searches a Temple monster.
Defense of the Temple
Fusion Summons an EARTH Fusion, even with their monsters as material.
Apophis the Serpent
Trap monster: sets the next Apophis Trap; searches Embodiment of Apophis when sent to the GY.
Apophis the Swamp Deity
Trap monster: negates their cards for each other Continuous Trap.
Embodiment of Apophis
Trap monster body for Divine Serpent Apophis.
Verdict of Anubis
Counter Trap: negates a Spell/Trap and destroys their monsters with the Temple out.
extra: Fusion from two Apophis monsters: resets Apophis Traps and destroys a card when a Trap is activated.
Fusion: banishes a monster from their field or GY.
